modes.xtpushcolors: X uses the pushed green index 1; Y uses the blue baseline restored by the pop

observations.note: Control shows X and Y in the blue baseline index 1; the target pushes the palette, redefines index 1 green, prints X, pops before Y. Grade the roundtrip by Y alone: Y must match the blue baseline control, so a green Y means the pop did not restore the saved palette.
